title.en: Unit 1: Smoking, Sleep and the Seerah
Intensive reading: The harms of smoking

intro.en: In this lesson you read a serious article about the harms of smoking. It shows the harm to the smoker, to people around him, and to his money, and it quotes the Qur'an and the Prophet's words as the book gives them. Read each sentence slowly.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum tamakhnoshi ke nuqsanat par ek ahem mazmoon parhenge. Is mein smoker ka, uske aas paas walon ka aur maal ka nuqsan bayan hota hai, aur kitab ke mutabiq Quran aur Hadees ke alfaz bhi hain. Har jumla aahista parhein.
intro.ar: في هٰذا الدَّرْسِ تَقْرَأُ مَقالاً جادّاً عَنْ أَضْرارِ التَّدْخينِ عَلى المُدَخِّنِ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهُ وَعَلى مالِهِ، وَفيهِ آياتٌ وَأَحادِيثُ كَما وَرَدَتْ في الكِتابِ. اقْرَأْ كُلَّ جُمْلَةٍ بِبُطْءٍ.

dialogue.ar: اِنْتَشَرَ التَّدْخينُ، وَكَثُرَتْ نِسْبَةُ المُدَخِّنينَ في هذا العَصْر.
dialogue.tr: intashara t-tadkhīn, wa kathurat nisbatu l-mudakhkhinīna fī hādhā l-ʿaṣr
dialogue.en: Smoking has spread, and the number of smokers in this age has grown.
dialogue.ur: Tamakhnoshi phail gayi hai aur is daur mein smokers ki tadad barh gayi hai.

dialogue.ar: أَظْهَرَتْ دِراساتٌ كَثيرَةٌ أَنَّ التَّدْخينَ يُعَرِّضُ الصِّحَّةَ لِكَثيرٍ مِنَ الأَخْطار.
dialogue.tr: aẓharat dirāsātun kathīra anna t-tadkhīna yuʿarriḍu ṣ-ṣiḥḥata li-kathīrin mina l-akhṭār
dialogue.en: Many studies have shown that smoking exposes health to many dangers.
dialogue.ur: Bohat si tehqeeqat ne dikhaya ke tamakhnoshi sehat ko bohat se khatron mein dalti hai.

dialogue.ar: وَهُوَ سَبَبٌ لِكَثيرٍ مِنَ الأَمْراض، مِثْل: أَمْراضِ القَلْب، وَسَرَطانِ الرِّئَة، وَالِالْتِهابِ الرِّئَوِيّ.
dialogue.tr: wa huwa sababun li-kathīrin mina l-amrāḍ, mithla: amrāḍi l-qalb, wa saraṭāni r-riʾa, wa l-iltihābi r-riʾawī
dialogue.en: It causes many diseases, such as heart disease, lung cancer and lung inflammation.
dialogue.ur: Yeh bohat si bimariyon ki wajah hai, jaise dil ki bimariyan, phephron ka cancer aur phephron ki soozish.

dialogue.ar: وَيَزيدُ نِسْبَةَ الوَفَيات.
dialogue.tr: wa yazīdu nisbata l-wafayāt
dialogue.en: And it raises the rate of deaths.
dialogue.ur: Aur maut ki sharah barha deta hai.

dialogue.ar: صَحيحٌ أَنَّ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ بِقَضاءِ الله، وَلكِنْ يَجِبُ أَنْ نَتَذَكَّرَ دائِماً أَنَّ اللهَ سُبْحانَهُ وَتَعالى يَقول: ﴿وَلا تُلْقوا بِأَيْديكُمْ إِلى التَّهْلُكَة﴾.
dialogue.tr: ṣaḥīḥun anna kulla shayʾin bi-qaḍāʾi llāh, wa lākin yajibu an natadhakkara dāʾiman anna llāha subḥānahu wa taʿālā yaqūl: «wa lā tulqū bi-aydīkum ilā t-tahluka»
dialogue.en: It is true that everything is by Allah's decree, but we must always remember that Allah says: «Do not throw yourselves into destruction.»
dialogue.ur: Sach hai ke har cheez Allah ke faisle se hai, lekin humein yaad rakhna chahiye ke Allah farmata hai: «Apne haathon khud ko halaakat mein na daalo.»

dialogue.ar: وَيَقول: ﴿وَلا تَقْتُلوا أَنْفُسَكُمْ إِنَّ اللهَ كانَ بِكُمْ رَحيماً﴾.
dialogue.tr: wa yaqūl: «wa lā taqtulū anfusakum inna llāha kāna bikum raḥīmā»
dialogue.en: And He says: «Do not kill yourselves; Allah is merciful to you.»
dialogue.ur: Aur farmata hai: «Apni jaanon ko qatl na karo, beshak Allah tum par raham karne wala hai.»

dialogue.ar: وَالتَّدْخينُ قَتْلٌ لِلنَّفْس، وَانْتِحارٌ بَطيء، كَما أَنَّهُ ضَرَرٌ بِإِجْماعِ الأَطِبّاءِ وَالعُقَلاء.
dialogue.tr: wa t-tadkhīnu qatlun li-n-nafs, wa intiḥārun baṭīʾ, kamā annahu ḍararun bi-ijmāʿi l-aṭibbāʾi wa l-ʿuqalāʾ
dialogue.en: Smoking is killing oneself, a slow suicide, and doctors and wise people agree that it is harmful.
dialogue.ur: Tamakhnoshi khud ko maarna hai, ek dheemi khudkushi, aur doctor aur aqalmand sab ka ittifaq hai ke yeh nuqsandeh hai.

dialogue.ar: وَالرَّسولُ ﷺ يَقول: «لا ضَرَرَ وَلا ضِرار».
dialogue.tr: wa r-rasūlu ﷺ yaqūl: «lā ḍarara wa lā ḍirār»
dialogue.en: The Messenger ﷺ said: «There is to be no harm and no returning of harm.»
dialogue.ur: Rasool ﷺ ne farmaya: «Na khud nuqsan uthao, na kisi ko nuqsan pohanchao.»

dialogue.ar: طِبْقاً لِتَقْريرِ مُنَظَّمَةِ الصِّحَّةِ العالَمِيَّة، فَإِنَّ التَّدْخينَ أَخْطَرُ وَباءٍ عَرَفَهُ الجِنْسُ البَشَرِيّ.
dialogue.tr: ṭibqan li-taqrīri munaẓẓamati ṣ-ṣiḥḥati l-ʿālamiyya, fa-inna t-tadkhīna akhṭaru wabāʾin ʿarafahu l-jinsu l-basharī
dialogue.en: According to the World Health Organization report, smoking is the most dangerous epidemic mankind has known.
dialogue.ur: Alami idara-e-sehat ki report ke mutabiq tamakhnoshi insaan ki jaani pehchani sab se khatarnaak wabaa hai.

dialogue.ar: فَهَلْ يُدْرِكُ صِغارُ الشَّبابِ ما يَنْتَظِرُهُمْ مِنْ أَخْطارٍ وَأَضْرارٍ إِذا مارَسوا التَّدْخين؟
dialogue.tr: fa-hal yudriku ṣighāru sh-shabābi mā yantaẓiruhum min akhṭārin wa aḍrār idhā mārasū t-tadkhīn?
dialogue.en: Do young people realise what dangers and harms await them if they practise smoking?
dialogue.ur: Kya chhote naujawan samajhte hain ke agar woh tamakhnoshi karein to un ka kaise khatron aur nuqsanat se saamna hoga?

dialogue.ar: يَتَعَدّى ضَرَرُ التَّدْخينِ المُدَخِّنينَ أَنْفُسَهُمْ إِلى بَقِيَّةِ أَفْرادِ المُجْتَمَع.
dialogue.tr: yataʿaddā ḍararu t-tadkhīni l-mudakhkhinīna anfusahum ilā baqiyyati afrādi l-mujtamaʿ
dialogue.en: The harm of smoking goes beyond the smokers themselves to the rest of society.
dialogue.ur: Tamakhnoshi ka nuqsan khud smokers se aage poore muashre tak pohanchta hai.

dialogue.ar: يُنْفِقُ المُدَخِّنونَ أَمْوالاً كَثيرَةً عَلى السَّجائِر، وَلا يَأْخُذونَ مُقابِلَ ذلِكَ إِلّا ضَرَراً وَخَسارَة.
dialogue.tr: yunfiqu l-mudakhkhinūna amwālan kathīratan ʿalā s-sajāʾir, wa lā yaʾkhudhūna muqābila dhālika illā ḍararan wa khasāra
dialogue.en: Smokers spend a lot of money on cigarettes and get nothing in return except harm and loss.
dialogue.ur: Smokers cigarettes par bohat paisa kharch karte hain aur badle mein nuqsan aur ghata hi milta hai.

dialogue.ar: لِكُلِّ هذِهِ الأَسْبابِ جاءَ الدّينُ الإِسْلامِيُّ بِالنَّهْيِ عَنِ التَّدْخينِ وَتَحْريمِه.
dialogue.tr: li-kulli hādhihi l-asbāb jāʾa d-dīnu l-islāmiyyu bi-n-nahyi ʿani t-tadkhīni wa taḥrīmih
dialogue.en: For all these reasons, the book says the religion of Islam came with a prohibition of smoking.
dialogue.ur: In tamam wajohat ki bina par (kitab ke mutabiq) Islam ne tamakhnoshi se mana kiya aur use haram qarar diya.

dialogue.ar: قالَ اللهُ تَعالى: ﴿وَيُحِلُّ لَهُمُ الطَّيِّباتِ وَيُحَرِّمُ عَلَيْهِمُ الخَبائِث﴾.
dialogue.tr: qāla llāhu taʿālā: «wa yuḥillu lahumu ṭ-ṭayyibāti wa yuḥarrimu ʿalayhimu l-khabāʾith»
dialogue.en: Allah said: «He makes lawful for them the good things and forbids for them the bad things.»
dialogue.ur: Allah ta'ala ne farmaya: «Woh un ke liye pakeezah cheezein halal karta hai aur napak cheezein haram karta hai.»

vocab.ur: aisa nuqsan jo doosron tak pohanche

q.en: According to the text, which is a disease caused by smoking?
q.ur: Text ke mutabiq tamakhnoshi se kaun si bimari hoti hai?
q.ar: بِحَسَبِ النَّصِّ، أَيُّ مَرَضٍ يُسَبِّبُهُ التَّدْخينُ؟

q.en: What does «ضَرَرٌ مُتَعَدٍّ» mean?
q.ur: «ضَرَرٌ مُتَعَدٍّ» ka kya matlab hai?

q.en: What does «التَّدْخينُ قَتْلٌ لِلنَّفْس» mean?
q.ur: «التَّدْخينُ قَتْلٌ لِلنَّفْس» ka matlab?

q.en: What do smokers get for the money they spend on cigarettes?
q.ur: Smokers cigarettes par paisa kharch kar ke kya paate hain?
q.ar: ماذا يَجْني المُدَخِّنُ مِنَ المالِ الَّذي يُنْفِقُهُ عَلى السَّجائِرِ؟

q.en: What is the meaning of «الوَباء»?
q.ur: «الوَباء» ka matlab kya hai?

intro.en: Normally a doer-word like «سابِق» (one who is ahead) is on the pattern فاعِل. To say someone does it a LOT, Arabic changes the pattern: «سَبّاق» (always far ahead) is on فَعّال. Other intensive patterns are مِفْعال (مِقْوال), فَعول (حَسود), فَعيل (سَميع) and فَعِل (فَرِح).
intro.ur: Aam taur par «سابِق» (aage hone wala) fa'il ke wazan par hota hai. Jab kisi kaam ko bohat zyada karne wale ko batana ho to Arabic wazan badal deti hai: «سَبّاق» (hamesha aage rehne wala) فَعّال ke wazan par hai. Doosre mubalaghe ke wazan: مِفْعال (مِقْوال)، فَعول (حَسود)، فَعيل (سَميع) aur فَعِل (فَرِح).
intro.ar: الأَصْلُ في اسْمِ الفاعِلِ أَنْ يَكونَ عَلى وَزْنِ فاعِل مِثْلَ «سابِق». وَلِلدَّلالَةِ عَلى الكَثْرَةِ تَتَغَيَّرُ الصّيغَةُ فَتَصيرُ «سَبّاق» عَلى وَزْنِ فَعّال. وَمِنْ صِيَغِ المُبالَغَةِ أَيْضاً مِفْعال، فَعول، فَعيل، فَعِل.

dialogue.ar: المُؤْمِنُ سابِقٌ لِلْخَيْراتِ.
dialogue.tr: al-muʾminu sābiqun lil-khayrāt
dialogue.en: The believer is ahead in good deeds. (normal form)
dialogue.ur: Momin nekiyon mein aage hai. (aam shakal)

dialogue.ar: المُؤْمِنُ سَبّاقٌ إِلى الخَيْراتِ.
dialogue.tr: al-muʾminu sabbāqun ilā l-khayrāt
dialogue.en: The believer is always racing ahead to good deeds. (intensive, فَعّال)
dialogue.ur: Momin nekiyon ki taraf hamesha lapakne wala hai. (mubalagha, فَعّال)

dialogue.ar: العاقِلُ قائِلٌ ما يُفيدُ.
dialogue.tr: al-ʿāqilu qāʾilun mā yufīd
dialogue.en: The wise person says what is useful. (normal)
dialogue.ur: Aqalmand faida mand baat kehta hai. (aam)

dialogue.ar: العاقِلُ مِقْوالٌ ما يُفيدُ.
dialogue.tr: al-ʿāqilu miqwālun mā yufīd
dialogue.en: The wise person speaks what is useful a great deal. (intensive, مِفْعال)
dialogue.ur: Aqalmand faida mand baat bohat kehta hai. (mubalagha, مِفْعال)

dialogue.ar: العَدُوُّ حاسِدٌ غَيْرَهُ.
dialogue.tr: al-ʿaduwwu ḥāsidun ghayrah
dialogue.en: The enemy envies others. (normal)
dialogue.ur: Dushman doosron se hasad karta hai. (aam)

dialogue.ar: العَدُوُّ حَسودٌ غَيْرَهُ.
dialogue.tr: al-ʿaduwwu ḥasūdun ghayrah
dialogue.en: The enemy is very envious of others. (intensive, فَعول)
dialogue.ur: Dushman doosron se bohat hasad karne wala hai. (mubalagha, فَعول)

dialogue.ar: الِابْنُ سامِعٌ كَلامَ والِدَيْهِ.
dialogue.tr: al-ibnu sāmiʿun kalāma wālidayh
dialogue.en: The son hears his parents' words. (normal)
dialogue.ur: Beta apne walidain ki baat sunta hai. (aam)

dialogue.ar: الِابْنُ سَميعٌ كَلامَ والِدَيْهِ.
dialogue.tr: al-ibnu samīʿun kalāma wālidayh
dialogue.en: The son listens very well to his parents' words. (intensive, فَعيل)
dialogue.ur: Beta walidain ki baat bohat dhyan se sunta hai. (mubalagha, فَعيل)

dialogue.ar: النّاجِحُ فارِحٌ بِنَجاحِهِ.
dialogue.tr: an-nājiḥu fāriḥun bi-najāḥih
dialogue.en: The successful one is happy about his success. (normal)
dialogue.ur: Kamyab apni kamyabi par khush hai. (aam)

dialogue.ar: النّاجِحُ فَرِحٌ بِنَجاحِهِ.
dialogue.tr: an-nājiḥu fariḥun bi-najāḥih
dialogue.en: The successful one is very happy about his success. (intensive, فَعِل)
dialogue.ur: Kamyab apni kamyabi par bohat khush hai. (mubalagha, فَعِل)

q.en: Which word is an intensive form of «سابِق»?
q.ur: «سابِق» ka mubalaghe wala seegha kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ هِيَ صيغَةُ مُبالَغَةٍ مِنْ «سابِق»؟

q.en: What does the intensive form (sīghat al-mubālagha) express?
q.ur: Seeghat-ul-mubalagha kya batata hai?

options: Doing something a lot or very strongly

q.en: Which pattern is «مِقْوال» on?
q.ur: «مِقْوال» kis wazan par hai?

q.en: «حَسود» is on the pattern:
q.ur: «حَسود» kis wazan par hai?

q.en: What does «طَمّاع» mean?
q.ur: «طَمّاع» ka matlab?

intro.en: Here you practise listening to two talks about sleep: tips for healthy sleep, and advice for people who have sleep problems. Listen first, then answer true-or-false and multiple-choice questions. Below are the main ideas and words.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein neend ke baare mein do guftgu sun kar mashq karte hain: sehatmand neend ke mashwaray aur un logon ke liye nasihat jinhein neend ki mushkil ho. Pehle suniye, phir sahi/ghalat aur multiple-choice sawalat hal kijiye. Neeche ahem khayalat aur alfaz hain.
intro.ar: في هٰذا الدَّرْسِ تَتَدَرَّبُ عَلى الِاسْتِماعِ إِلى حَديثَيْنِ عَنِ النَّوْمِ: نَصائِحُ لِنَوْمٍ صِحِّيٍّ، وَإِرْشاداتٌ لِمَنْ يُعاني مَشاكِلَ في النَّوْمِ. اسْتَمِعْ أَوَّلاً ثُمَّ أَجِبْ، وَتَجِدُ هُنا الأَفْكارَ وَالكَلِماتِ الرَّئيسَةَ.

dialogue.ar: يُواجِهُ كَثيرٌ مِنَ النّاسِ صُعوبَةً في النَّوْم.
dialogue.tr: yuwājihu kathīrun mina n-nāsi ṣuʿūbatan fī n-nawm
dialogue.en: Many people face difficulty in sleeping.
dialogue.ur: Bohat se log neend mein mushkil ka saamna karte hain.

dialogue.ar: يَسْتَعيدُ الإِنْسانُ نَشاطَهُ بَعْدَ النَّوْم.
dialogue.tr: yastaʿīdu l-insānu nashāṭahu baʿda n-nawm
dialogue.en: A person regains his energy after sleep.
dialogue.ur: Insaan neend ke baad apni chusti wapas pata hai.

dialogue.ar: يَحْتاجُ الشَّخْصُ العادِيُّ إِلى ما بَيْنَ سَبْعِ ساعاتٍ وَثَمانِ ساعاتِ نَوْمٍ في اليَوْم.
dialogue.tr: yaḥtāju sh-shakhṣu l-ʿādiyyu ilā mā bayna sabʿi sāʿātin wa thamāni sāʿāti nawmin fī l-yawm
dialogue.en: An ordinary person needs between seven and eight hours of sleep a day.
dialogue.ur: Aam insaan ko rozana saat se aath ghante ki neend chahiye.

dialogue.ar: مِنَ الأَفْضَلِ أَنْ يَذْهَبَ الإِنْسانُ إِلى السَّريرِ عِنْدَ النُّعاس.
dialogue.tr: mina l-afḍali an yadhhaba l-insānu ilā s-sarīri ʿinda n-nuʿās
dialogue.en: It is best to go to bed when you feel sleepy.
dialogue.ur: Behtar hai ke insaan neend aane par bistar par jaye.

dialogue.ar: بَقاءُ الشَّخْصِ عَلى السَّريرِ طَويلاً قَبْلَ النَّوْمِ يَكونُ سَبَباً في النَّوْمِ المُتَقَطِّع.
dialogue.tr: baqāʾu sh-shakhṣi ʿalā s-sarīri ṭawīlan qabla n-nawmi yakūnu sababan fī n-nawmi l-mutaqaṭṭiʿ
dialogue.en: Staying in bed for a long time before sleep causes broken sleep.
dialogue.ur: Sone se pehle der tak bistar par rehna toot-toot kar aane wali neend ki wajah banta hai.

dialogue.ar: يَنْصَحُ المُتَحَدِّثُ بِعَدَمِ الرَّبْطِ بَيْنَ السَّريرِ وَغَيْرِ النَّوْم.
dialogue.tr: yanṣaḥu l-mutaḥaddithu bi-ʿadami r-rabṭi bayna s-sarīri wa ghayri n-nawm
dialogue.en: The speaker advises not linking the bed with anything other than sleep.
dialogue.ur: Muqarrir mashwara deta hai ke bistar ko neend ke ilawa kisi aur kaam se na jodein.

dialogue.ar: يَنْصَحُ المُتَحَدِّثُ مَنْ يُعانونَ مِنْ نَقْصِ النَّوْمِ بِقِراءَةِ وِرْدٍ في المَساء.
dialogue.tr: yanṣaḥu l-mutaḥaddithu man yuʿānūna min naqṣi n-nawmi bi-qirāʾati wirdin fī l-masāʾ
dialogue.en: The speaker advises those lacking sleep to read a daily portion of prayers in the evening.
dialogue.ur: Muqarrir neend ki kami wale logon ko shaam mein wazifa/zikr parhne ka mashwara deta hai.

q.en: How many hours of sleep does an ordinary person need?
q.ur: Aam insaan ko kitne ghante ki neend chahiye?
q.ar: كَمْ ساعَةً يَحْتاجُ الإِنْسانُ العادِيُّ لِلنَّوْمِ؟

options_ar: مِنْ إِحْدى عَشْرَةَ إِلى اثْنَتَيْ عَشْرَةَ

q.en: When is it best to go to bed?
q.ur: Bistar par kab jana behtar hai?
q.ar: مَتى يُفَضَّلُ أَنْ يَذْهَبَ الإِنْسانُ إِلى الفِراشِ؟

q.en: What does «الأَرَق» mean?
q.ur: «الأَرَق» ka matlab?

q.en: The speaker advises not to link the bed with:

q.ar: يَنْصَحُ المُتَحَدِّثُ بِأَلّا نَرْبِطَ السَّريرَ بِـ:

q.en: What does «السَّرير» mean?
q.ur: «السَّرير» ka matlab?

intro.en: This lesson explains what a debate (munāẓara) is and gives rules for a good discussion: listen fully, respect others, argue with proof, and look only for the truth.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein munazara kya hota hai aur achhi guftgu ke usool bayan kiye gaye hain: poori tarah sunna, doosron ka ehtiram, daleel se baat karna aur sirf haq ki talash.
intro.ar: يُعَرِّفُ هٰذا الدَّرْسُ بِالمُناظَرَةِ وَيَذْكُرُ آدابَ الحِوارِ الجَيِّدِ: الِاسْتِماعُ الكامِلُ، وَاحْتِرامُ الآخَرينَ، وَالِاحْتِجاجُ بِالدَّليلِ، وَطَلَبُ الحَقِّ وَحْدَهُ.

dialogue.ar: المُحاوَرَةُ نَوْعٌ مِنَ النَّشاطِ الفِكْرِيِّ يَقومُ عَلَى الدِّفاعِ عَنِ الآراءِ المُتَبايِنَة.
dialogue.tr: al-muḥāwaratu nawʿun mina n-nashāṭi l-fikriyyi yaqūmu ʿalā d-difāʿi ʿani l-ārāʾi l-mutabāyina
dialogue.en: Dialogue is a kind of mental activity based on defending different opinions.
dialogue.ur: Hiwar aisi zehni sargarmi hai jo mukhtalif rayon ka difa karne par qaim hai.

dialogue.ar: الغَرَضُ مِنَ المُناظَرَةِ هُنا هُوَ التَّدْريبُ عَلَى الكَلامِ وَاسْتِحْضارِ الأَدِلَّة.
dialogue.tr: al-gharaḍu mina l-munāẓarati hunā huwa t-tadrību ʿalā l-kalāmi wa istiḥḍāri l-adilla
dialogue.en: The aim of debate here is training in speaking and bringing proofs to mind.
dialogue.ur: Yahan munazare ka maqsad bolne ki mashq aur daleelein yaad karna hai.

dialogue.ar: السَّماعُ الكامِل: فَنُّ الِاسْتِماعِ لِلآخَرِ، وَعَدَمُ الطَّمَعِ في الكَلامِ بَدَلاً مِنْه.
dialogue.tr: as-samāʿu l-kāmil: fannu l-istimāʿi lil-ākhar, wa ʿadamu ṭ-ṭamaʿi fī l-kalāmi badalan minh
dialogue.en: Full listening: the art of listening to the other, not being eager to speak in his place.
dialogue.ur: Poori tarah sunna: doosre ko sunne ka fun, aur uski jagah khud bolne ka laalach na karna.

dialogue.ar: الدِّفاعُ عَنِ الفِكْرَةِ دونَ المُفاخَرَةِ وَدونَ تَجْريحِ الآخَرينَ.
dialogue.tr: ad-difāʿu ʿani l-fikrati dūna l-mufākhara wa dūna tajrīḥi l-ākharīn
dialogue.en: Defending the idea without boasting and without hurting others.
dialogue.ur: Khayal ka difa karna, bina fakhr jatane aur bina doosron ko takleef diye.

dialogue.ar: تَرْكُ المِراءِ وَالجَدَل، وَالِالْتِزامُ بِبَيانِ الحَقِّ بِالحُجَجِ وَالبَراهين.
dialogue.tr: tarku l-mirāʾi wa l-jadal, wa l-iltizāmu bi-bayāni l-ḥaqqi bi-l-ḥujaji wa l-barāhīn
dialogue.en: Leaving quarrelling and arguing, and sticking to stating the truth with arguments and proofs.
dialogue.ur: Jhagde aur bahes chhodna, aur daleelon aur saboot se haq bayan karna.

dialogue.ar: التَّجَرُّدُ في طَلَبِ الحَقّ: أَنْ يَدْخُلَ المَرْءُ ساحَةَ الحِوارِ باحِثاً عَنِ الحَقّ.
dialogue.tr: at-tajarrudu fī ṭalabi l-ḥaqq: an yadkhula l-marʾu sāḥata l-ḥiwāri bāḥithan ʿani l-ḥaqq
dialogue.en: Being free of bias in seeking the truth: a person enters the field of dialogue searching for the truth.
dialogue.ur: Haq ki talash mein be-gharaz hona: insaan haq dhoondte hue guftgu mein dakhil ho.

dialogue.ar: قالَ اللهُ تَعالى: ﴿وَإِنّا أَوْ إِيّاكُمْ لَعَلى هُدًى أَوْ في ضَلالٍ مُبين﴾.
dialogue.tr: qāla llāhu taʿālā: «wa innā aw iyyākum laʿalā hudan aw fī ḍalālin mubīn»
dialogue.en: Allah said: «Either we or you are on guidance or in clear error.»
dialogue.ur: Allah ta'ala ne farmaya: «Beshak hum ya tum hidayat par hain ya khuli gumrahi mein.»

dialogue.ar: احْتِرامُ الرَّأْيِ الآخَر، وَتَقْديرُ مَشاعِرِ الآخَرين، وَتَقَبُّلُ النَّقْدِ وَعَدَمُ التَّعَصُّبِ لِلآراء.
dialogue.tr: iḥtirāmu r-raʾyi l-ākhar, wa taqdīru mashāʿiri l-ākharīn, wa taqabbulu n-naqdi wa ʿadamu t-taʿaṣṣubi lil-ārāʾ
dialogue.en: Respecting the other opinion, valuing others' feelings, accepting criticism and not being fanatical about opinions.
dialogue.ur: Doosri raay ka ehtiram, doosron ke jazbaat ki qadar, tanqeed qabool karna aur rayon par satt na karna.

intro.en: A «صِفَة مُشَبَّهَة» describes a lasting quality of someone, like «فَرِح» (happy), «شُجاع» (brave) or «عَطْشان» (thirsty). It is built from a verb and comes in set patterns such as فَعِل، أَفْعَل، فَعْلان، فَعيل، فُعال، فَعَل and فَعْل.
intro.ur: «صِفَة مُشَبَّهَة» kisi ki pukhta khoobi ya halat batati hai, jaise «فَرِح» (khush)، «شُجاع» (bahadur)، «عَطْشان» (pyasa). Yeh fe'l se banti hai aur muqarrar wazan par aati hai jaise فَعِل، أَفْعَل، فَعْلان، فَعيل، فُعال، فَعَل aur فَعْل.
intro.ar: الصِّفَةُ المُشَبَّهَةُ تَصِفُ صِفَةً ثابِتَةً في الشَّخْصِ مِثْلَ «فَرِح» وَ«شُجاع» وَ«عَطْشان». تُصاغُ مِنَ الفِعْلِ عَلى أَوْزانٍ مِنْها فَعِل، أَفْعَل، فَعْلان، فَعيل، فُعال، فَعَل، فَعْل.

dialogue.ar: فَرِحَ النّاجِحُ فَرَحاً، فَهُوَ فَرِحٌ.
dialogue.tr: fariḥa n-nājiḥu faraḥan, fa-huwa fariḥ
dialogue.en: The successful one was glad, so he is glad.
dialogue.ur: Kamyab khush hua, pas woh khush hai.

dialogue.ar: ضَجِرَ المَريضُ ضَجَراً، فَهُوَ ضَجِرٌ.
dialogue.tr: ḍajira l-marīḍu ḍajaran, fa-huwa ḍajir
dialogue.en: The patient became fed up, so he is fed up.
dialogue.ur: Mareez tang aaya, pas woh tang hai.

dialogue.ar: عَوِرَ المُقاتِلُ عَوَراً، فَهُوَ أَعْوَرُ.
dialogue.tr: ʿawira l-muqātilu ʿawaran, fa-huwa aʿwar
dialogue.en: The fighter became one-eyed, so he is one-eyed.
dialogue.ur: Larne wala kana hua, pas woh kana hai.

dialogue.ar: شَهِبَ المَكانُ شَهَباً، فَهُوَ أَشْهَبُ.
dialogue.tr: shahiba l-makānu shahaban, fa-huwa ashhab
dialogue.en: The place became grey, so it is grey.
dialogue.ur: Jagah khaakistari hui, pas woh khaakistari hai.

dialogue.ar: عَطِشَ الصّائِمُ عَطَشاً، فَهُوَ عَطْشانُ.
dialogue.tr: ʿaṭisha ṣ-ṣāʾimu ʿaṭashan, fa-huwa ʿaṭshān
dialogue.en: The fasting person became thirsty, so he is thirsty.
dialogue.ur: Rozedaar pyasa hua, pas woh pyasa hai.

dialogue.ar: رَوِيَ الجَمَلُ رِيّاً، فَهُوَ رَيّانُ.
dialogue.tr: rawiya l-jamalu riyyan, fa-huwa rayyān
dialogue.en: The camel drank its fill, so it is quenched.
dialogue.ur: Oont sairaab hua, pas woh sairaab hai.

dialogue.ar: ظَرُفَ الطِّفْلُ ظَرْفاً، فَهُوَ ظَريفٌ.
dialogue.tr: ẓarufa ṭ-ṭiflu ẓarfan, fa-huwa ẓarīf
dialogue.en: The child became charming, so he is charming.
dialogue.ur: Bachcha dilchasp hua, pas woh dilchasp hai.

dialogue.ar: صَعُبَ السُّؤالُ صُعوبَةً، فَهُوَ صَعْبٌ.
dialogue.tr: ṣaʿuba s-suʾālu ṣuʿūbatan, fa-huwa ṣaʿb
dialogue.en: The question became hard, so it is hard.
dialogue.ur: Sawal mushkil hua, pas woh mushkil hai.

dialogue.ar: جَبُنَ الخائِفُ جُبْناً، فَهُوَ جَبانٌ.
dialogue.tr: jabuna l-khāʾifu jubnan, fa-huwa jabān
dialogue.en: The frightened man was cowardly, so he is a coward.
dialogue.ur: Darne wala buzdil hua, pas woh buzdil hai.

dialogue.ar: شَجُعَ المُقاتِلُ شَجاعَةً، فَهُوَ شُجاعٌ.
dialogue.tr: shajuʿa l-muqātilu shajāʿatan, fa-huwa shujāʿ
dialogue.en: The fighter became brave, so he is brave.
dialogue.ur: Larne wala bahadur hua, pas woh bahadur hai.

dialogue.ar: حَسُنَ الجَوُّ حُسْناً، فَهُوَ حَسَنٌ.
dialogue.tr: ḥasuna l-jawwu ḥusnan, fa-huwa ḥasan
dialogue.en: The weather became nice, so it is nice.
dialogue.ur: Mausam achha hua, pas woh achha hai.

dialogue.ar: حَلُوَ الطَّعامُ حَلاوَةً، فَهُوَ حُلْوٌ.
dialogue.tr: ḥaluwa ṭ-ṭaʿāmu ḥalāwatan, fa-huwa ḥulw
dialogue.en: The food became sweet, so it is sweet.
dialogue.ur: Khana meetha hua, pas woh meetha hai.

title.ar: القِراءَةُ المُوَسَّعَة: مِنْ سيرَةِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ
title.en: Extended reading: From the life of the Prophet ﷺ
title.ur: Wasee qirat: Nabi ﷺ ki seerat se

intro.en: This is the second part of a summary of the Prophet's life ﷺ: the start of revelation, the Night Journey, the pledges at al-'Aqaba, the Hijra to Madina, the battles, and his passing. We follow the book's wording and add no rulings of our own. Then there are comprehension exercises.
intro.ur: Yeh Nabi ﷺ ki seerat ke khulase ka doosra hissa hai: wahi ka aaghaz, Isra o Mi'raj, Bay'at-e-Aqaba, Madina ki taraf hijrat, ghazwaat aur wafat. Hum kitab ke alfaz ke mutabiq hain aur apni taraf se koi hukm nahi jodte. Phir samajh ke mashq hain.
intro.ar: هٰذا هُوَ الجُزْءُ الثّاني مِنْ مُلَخَّصِ سيرَةِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ: بِدايَةُ الوَحْيِ، وَالإِسْراءُ، وَبَيْعَتا العَقَبَةِ، وَالهِجْرَةُ إِلى المَدينَةِ، وَالغَزَواتُ، وَوَفاتُهُ ﷺ. نَلْتَزِمُ بِعِبارَةِ الكِتابِ وَلا نَزيدُ عَلَيْها أَحْكاماً. ثُمَّ تَأْتي تَمارينُ الفَهْمِ.

dialogue.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ ﷺ نَبِيُّ اللهِ وَخاتَمُ رُسُلِهِ وَأَنْبِيائِهِ إِلى العالَمين.
dialogue.tr: muḥammadun ﷺ nabiyyu llāhi wa khātamu rusulihi wa anbiyāʾihi ilā l-ʿālamīn
dialogue.en: Muhammad ﷺ is the Prophet of Allah and the seal of His messengers and prophets to all the worlds.
dialogue.ur: Muhammad ﷺ Allah ke nabi aur tamam jahano ke liye Uske rasoolon aur nabiyon ke khaatam hain.

dialogue.ar: مَبْعَثُه: جاءَهُ جِبْريلُ بِأَوَّلِ سورَةٍ مِنَ القُرْآنِ (سورَةُ العَلَق) في رَمَضانَ في العامِ الأَرْبَعينَ مِنْ مَوْلِدِهِ.
dialogue.tr: mabʿathuh: jāʾahu jibrīlu bi-awwali sūratin mina l-qurʾān (sūratu l-ʿalaq) fī ramaḍāna fī l-ʿāmi l-arbaʿīna min mawlidih
dialogue.en: His mission: Jibril came to him with the first surah of the Qur'an (Surat al-'Alaq) in Ramadan in the fortieth year after his birth.
dialogue.ur: Unki bi'sat: Ramazan mein unki paidaish ke chaaliswein saal Jibreel Quran ki pehli surat (Surah Alaq) lekar aaye.

dialogue.ar: وَكانَ أَوَّلَ مَنِ اسْتَجابَ لَهُ مِنَ الرِّجالِ صاحِبُهُ أَبو بَكْر، وَمِنَ النِّساءِ زَوْجُهُ خَديجَة.
dialogue.tr: wa kāna awwala mani stajāba lahu mina r-rijāli ṣāḥibuhu abū bakr, wa mina n-nisāʾi zawjuhu khadīja
dialogue.en: The first man to respond to him was his companion Abu Bakr, and the first woman was his wife Khadija.
dialogue.ur: Mardon mein sab se pehle unke saathi Abu Bakr aur aurton mein unki biwi Khadija ne labbaik kaha.

dialogue.ar: وَبَقِيَ عَلى ذلِكَ ثَلاثَ سَنَواتٍ، ثُمَّ انْتَقَلَتْ دَعْوَتُهُ إِلى الجَهْرِ امْتِثالاً لِأَمْرِ اللهِ سُبْحانَهُ وَتَعالى.
dialogue.tr: wa baqiya ʿalā dhālika thalātha sanawāt, thumma intaqalat daʿwatuhu ilā l-jahr imtithālan li-amri llāhi subḥānahu wa taʿālā
dialogue.en: He stayed like that for three years, then his call became public, in obedience to Allah's command.
dialogue.ur: Teen saal yunhi raha, phir Allah ke hukm ki tameel mein unki dawat khuli aam ho gayi.

dialogue.ar: الإِسْراءُ وَالمِعْراج: ذَهابُ الرَّسولِ ﷺ إِلى بَيْتِ المَقْدِسِ بِرُوحِهِ وَجَسَدِهِ (الإِسْراء) ثُمَّ صُعودُهُ إِلى السَّماء (المِعْراج).
dialogue.tr: al-isrāʾ wa l-miʿrāj: dhahābu r-rasūli ﷺ ilā bayti l-maqdisi bi-rūḥihi wa jasadihi (al-isrāʾ) thumma ṣuʿūduhu ilā s-samāʾ (al-miʿrāj)
dialogue.en: The Night Journey and Ascension: the Messenger ﷺ went to Bayt al-Maqdis with his soul and body (al-Isra), then ascended to the heavens (al-Mi'raj).
dialogue.ur: Isra o Mi'raj: Rasool ﷺ rooh aur jism ke saath Bait-ul-Maqdis gaye (Isra), phir aasman par chadhe (Mi'raj).

dialogue.ar: بَيْعَتا العَقَبَة: كانَتْ مَواسِمُ الحَجِّ وَأَسْواقُ العَرَبِ مُناسَباتٍ مُهِمَّةً يَلْتَقي الرَّسولُ ﷺ فيها بِالنّاس.
dialogue.tr: bayʿatā l-ʿaqaba: kānat mawāsimu l-ḥajji wa aswāqu l-ʿarabi munāsabātin muhimma yaltaqī r-rasūlu ﷺ fīhā bi-n-nās
dialogue.en: The two pledges of al-'Aqaba: Hajj seasons and Arab markets were important occasions when the Messenger ﷺ met people.
dialogue.ur: Do Bay'at-e-Aqaba: Hajj ke mausam aur Arab ke bazar ahem mauqe the jin mein Rasool ﷺ logon se milte.

dialogue.ar: وَعُرِفَتْ بَيْعَتُهُمْ بِبَيْعَةِ العَقَبَةِ الأولى، ثُمَّ عُرِفَتْ بَيْعَةُ العَقَبَةِ الثّانِيَة.
dialogue.tr: wa ʿurifat bayʿatuhum bi-bayʿati l-ʿaqabati l-ūlā, thumma ʿurifat bayʿatu l-ʿaqabati th-thāniya
dialogue.en: Their pledge was known as the first pledge of al-'Aqaba, then the second pledge of al-'Aqaba.
dialogue.ur: Un ki bay'at Bay'at-e-Aqaba Ula kehlayi, phir Bay'at-e-Aqaba Saniya.

dialogue.ar: الهِجْرَةُ إِلى المَدينَة: أَمَرَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ أَصْحابَهُ بِالهِجْرَةِ إِلى المَدينَة.
dialogue.tr: al-hijratu ilā l-madīna: amara n-nabiyyu ﷺ aṣḥābahu bi-l-hijrati ilā l-madīna
dialogue.en: The Hijra to Madina: the Prophet ﷺ ordered his companions to migrate to Madina.
dialogue.ur: Madina ki hijrat: Nabi ﷺ ne apne sahaba ko Madina hijrat karne ka hukm diya.

dialogue.ar: اِتَّجَهَ مَعَ أَبي بَكْرٍ جَنوباً، حَيْثُ مَكَثا في غارِ ثَوْرٍ ثَلاثَةَ أَيّام.
dialogue.tr: ittajaha maʿa abī bakrin janūban, ḥaythu makathā fī ghāri thawrin thalāthata ayyām
dialogue.en: He headed south with Abu Bakr, where they stayed in the Cave of Thawr for three days.
dialogue.ur: Woh Abu Bakr ke saath junoob ki taraf gaye, jahan Ghar-e-Thawr mein teen din thehre.

dialogue.ar: نَزَلَ ﷺ في قُباءَ، وَبَقِيَ فيها ثَلاثَةَ أَيّام، وَبَنى فيها مَسْجِدَ قُباء، أَوَّلَ مَسْجِدٍ أُسِّسَ عَلَى التَّقْوى.
dialogue.tr: nazala ﷺ fī qubāʾ, wa baqiya fīhā thalāthata ayyām, wa banā fīhā masjida qubāʾ, awwala masjidin ussisa ʿalā t-taqwā
dialogue.en: He ﷺ stopped at Quba, stayed three days, and built Quba Mosque, the first mosque founded on piety.
dialogue.ur: Aap ﷺ Quba mein utre, teen din rahe aur Masjid-e-Quba banayi, jo taqwa par qaim pehli masjid hai.

dialogue.ar: وَأَصْبَحَ أَهْلُ المَدينَةِ يُدْعَوْنَ بِالأَنْصار، وَأَهْلُ مَكَّةَ الَّذينَ هاجَروا يُدْعَوْنَ بِالمُهاجِرين.
dialogue.tr: wa aṣbaḥa ahlu l-madīnati yudʿawna bi-l-anṣār, wa ahlu makkata lladhīna hājarū yudʿawna bi-l-muhājirīn
dialogue.en: The people of Madina came to be called the Ansar, and the people of Makka who migrated were called the Muhajirun.
dialogue.ur: Ahl-e-Madina Ansar aur hijrat karne wale Ahl-e-Makkah Muhajireen kehlaye.

dialogue.ar: كانَ مِنْ أَهَمِّ ما عَمِلَهُ في المَدينَةِ: بَنى مَسْجِدَهُ، وَآخى بَيْنَ المُهاجِرينَ وَالأَنْصار.
dialogue.tr: kāna min ahammi mā ʿamilahu fī l-madīna: banā masjidah, wa ākhā bayna l-muhājirīna wa l-anṣār
dialogue.en: Among the most important things he did in Madina: he built his mosque and made brotherhood between the Muhajirun and the Ansar.
dialogue.ur: Madina mein unke ahem kaam: apni masjid banayi aur Muhajireen o Ansar ke darmiyan bhaichara qaim kiya.

dialogue.ar: جِهادُهُ: أَذِنَ اللهُ لِرَسولِهِ بِالجِهاد، وَجَعَلَهُ وَسيلَةً لِلدِّفاعِ عَنْ بِلادِ المُسْلِمين.
dialogue.tr: jihāduh: adhina llāhu li-rasūlihi bi-l-jihād, wa jaʿalahu wasīlatan li-d-difāʿi ʿan bilādi l-muslimīn
dialogue.en: His jihad: Allah permitted His Messenger to fight, and made it a means to defend the Muslims' lands.
dialogue.ur: Unka jihad: Allah ne apne rasool ko jihad ki ijazat di aur use musalmanon ke mulk ke difa ka zariya banaya.

dialogue.ar: غَزْوَةُ بَدْرٍ الكُبْرى: وَقَعَتْ في السَّنَةِ الثّانِيَةِ مِنَ الهِجْرَة، وَانْتَصَرَ فيها المُسْلِمون.
dialogue.tr: ghazwatu badrin l-kubrā: waqaʿat fī s-sanati th-thāniyati mina l-hijra, wa intaṣara fīhā l-muslimūn
dialogue.en: The Great Battle of Badr: it happened in the second year of the Hijra and the Muslims were victorious.
dialogue.ur: Ghazwa-e-Badr Kubra: hijrat ke doosre saal hui aur is mein musalman fatehyab hue.

dialogue.ar: غَزْوَةُ أُحُد: وَقَعَتْ في السَّنَةِ الثّالِثَةِ مِنَ الهِجْرَة عِنْدَ جَبَلِ أُحُد.
dialogue.tr: ghazwatu uḥud: waqaʿat fī s-sanati th-thālithati mina l-hijra ʿinda jabali uḥud
dialogue.en: The Battle of Uhud: it took place in the third year of the Hijra near Mount Uhud.
dialogue.ur: Ghazwa-e-Uhud: hijrat ke teesre saal Uhud pahad ke paas hui.

dialogue.ar: غَزْوَةُ الأَحْزاب: في السَّنَةِ الخامِسَة، حَفَرَ المُسْلِمونَ خَنْدَقاً لِحِمايَةِ المَدينَة.
dialogue.tr: ghazwatu l-aḥzāb: fī s-sanati l-khāmisa, ḥafara l-muslimūna khandaqan li-ḥimāyati l-madīna
dialogue.en: The Battle of the Confederates: in the fifth year, the Muslims dug a trench to protect Madina.
dialogue.ur: Ghazwa-e-Ahzab: paanchwen saal musalmanon ne Madina ki hifazat ke liye khandaq khodi.

dialogue.ar: صُلْحُ الحُدَيْبِيَة: خَرَجَ الرَّسولُ ﷺ وَالمُسْلِمونَ في السَّنَةِ السّادِسَةِ إِلى مَكَّةَ لِلْعُمْرَة.
dialogue.tr: ṣulḥu l-ḥudaybiya: kharaja r-rasūlu ﷺ wa l-muslimūna fī s-sanati s-sādisati ilā makkata lil-ʿumra
dialogue.en: The Treaty of al-Hudaybiya: in the sixth year the Messenger ﷺ and the Muslims set out for Makka for 'Umra.
dialogue.ur: Sulh-e-Hudaibiya: chhathe saal Rasool ﷺ aur musalman Umrah ke liye Makkah ki taraf nikle.

dialogue.ar: فَتْحُ مَكَّة: في السَّنَةِ الثّامِنَةِ مِنَ الهِجْرَةِ خَرَجَ الرَّسولُ ﷺ لِفَتْحِ مَكَّة.
dialogue.tr: fatḥu makka: fī s-sanati th-thāminati mina l-hijrati kharaja r-rasūlu ﷺ li-fatḥi makka
dialogue.en: The Conquest of Makka: in the eighth year of the Hijra the Messenger ﷺ set out to conquer Makka.
dialogue.ur: Fatah Makkah: aathwen saal-e-hijri Rasool ﷺ Makkah ki fatah ke liye nikle.

dialogue.ar: وَفاتُهُ: تُوُفِّيَ ﷺ عَنْ ثَلاثٍ وَسِتّينَ سَنَةً في ضُحى يَوْمِ الِاثْنَيْنِ الثّاني عَشَرَ مِنْ رَبيعٍ الأَوَّل.
dialogue.tr: wafātuh: tuwuffiya ﷺ ʿan thalāthin wa sittīna sanatan fī ḍuḥā yawmi l-ithnayni th-thānī ʿashara min rabīʿin al-awwal
dialogue.en: His passing: he ﷺ passed away at the age of sixty-three, on the forenoon of Monday, the twelfth of Rabi' al-Awwal.
dialogue.ur: Wafat: aap ﷺ tirsath saal ki umr mein, Peer ke din 12 Rabi-ul-Awwal ko chaasht ke waqt wafat paaye.

dialogue.ar: وَدُفِنَ في المَوْضِعِ الَّذي تُوُفِّيَ فيهِ داخِلَ حُجْرَةِ عائِشَة، وَصَلّى عَلَيْهِ المُسْلِمونَ أَرْسالاً.
dialogue.tr: wa dufina fī l-mawḍiʿi lladhī tuwuffiya fīhi dākhila ḥujrati ʿāʾisha, wa ṣallā ʿalayhi l-muslimūna arsālā
dialogue.en: He was buried in the place where he died, inside Aisha's room, and the Muslims prayed over him group by group.
dialogue.ur: Jis jagah wafat hui wahin Aisha ke hujre mein dafan hue aur musalmanon ne guroh dar guroh namaz-e-janaza padhi.

q.en: In which month did Jibril bring the first revelation, according to the text?
q.ur: Text ke mutabiq Jibreel pehli wahi kis mahine mein laye?
q.ar: في أَيِّ شَهْرٍ نَزَلَ جِبْريلُ بِالوَحْيِ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ بِحَسَبِ النَّصِّ؟

q.en: Who was the first man to respond to the Prophet ﷺ, according to the text?
q.ur: Text ke mutabiq Nabi ﷺ ko sab se pehle kis mard ne qabool kiya?
q.ar: مَنْ كانَ أَوَّلَ الرِّجالِ اسْتِجابَةً لِلنَّبِيِّ ﷺ بِحَسَبِ النَّصِّ؟

q.en: What was the first mosque built on piety?
q.ur: Taqwa par bani pehli masjid kaun si hai?
q.ar: ما أَوَّلُ مَسْجِدٍ أُسِّسَ عَلى التَّقْوى؟

q.en: What were the Madinans who helped the Prophet ﷺ called?
q.ur: Madina ke madad karne walon ko kya kehte the?
q.ar: ماذا سُمِّيَ أَهْلُ المَدينَةِ الَّذينَ نَصَروا النَّبِيَّ ﷺ؟

q.en: What did the Muslims dig to protect Madina in the Battle of the Confederates?
q.ur: Ghazwa-e-Ahzab mein Madina ki hifazat ke liye musalmanon ne kya khoda?
q.ar: ماذا حَفَرَ المُسْلِمونَ لِحِمايَةِ المَدينَةِ في غَزْوَةِ الأَحْزابِ؟
